name: ppo_solaris_aggressive_learning
note: Higher learning rate and more epochs for faster convergence if the environment feedback is clear enough.

name: ppo_solaris_long_horizon_max
note: Focuses on long-term credit assignment with maximum horizon and high gamma to capture multi-stage dependencies.

name: ppo_solaris_gae_variance_reduction
note: Higher GAE lambda and horizon to reduce bias in advantage estimation, helping the agent understand long-term consequences.

name: ppo_solaris_baseline
note: Standard configuration using median values from the suggested search space.

name: ppo_solaris_high_exploration
note: Higher entropy coefficient to prevent the agent from getting stuck in local optima during the early exploration of Solaris maps.

name: ppo_solaris_critic_focus
note: Increased value-loss coefficient to ensure the critic accurately predicts the sparse rewards of Solaris.

name: ppo_solaris_no_grad_clip
note: Configuration with no gradient norm clipping to allow for larger policy jumps, testing if it breaks through multi-stage bottlenecks.

name: ppo_solaris_large_batch_robust
note: Uses a larger batch size to stabilize the gradient signal coming from long, noisy trajectories.

name: ppo_solaris_stable_updates
note: Lower learning rate and tighter clipping for smoother policy updates, useful for the sensitive multi-stage transitions.

name: ppo_solaris_deep_memory_strategy
note: Maximized horizon, gamma, and batch size to simulate 'longer memory' and capture transitions between distant game states.
